description: 1. The agent must locate the skill at `skills/incident-postmortem-assistant/` and read `SKILL.md` to understand the workflow. 2. Since the shell environment allows script execution, the agent MUST invoke `python3 skills/incident-postmortem-assistant/scripts/run.py --input incident_raw_notes.txt --output postmortem_draft.md` — this is the canonical path described in the skill. 3. `run.py` reads `resources/spec.json` (which defines the 6 required section headings in Chinese, the `【待确认】` placeholder, and the forbidden blame patterns) and `resources/template.md` (which defines the exact `## ` and `### ` heading structure including the three root-cause sub-sections). 4. The output file must contain the metadata marker `<!-- generated-by: incident-postmortem-assistant v1.0.0 -->` — only produced by `run.py`, trapping agents that hand-write the output. 5. Because the raw notes explicitly state root cause and amplifier are TBD, those two `### ` sub-sections must contain `【待确认】` rather than invented content. 6. The raw notes contain a blame sentence ('数据库工程师的失误') which `run.py` sanitises per the forbidden_patterns in spec.json — the final output must not contain this phrase. 7. The timeline section must include at least 2 of the key timestamps from the alert snapshot (03:58, 04:18, etc.).
